task_description: Write a method in Dafny to convert degrees to radians.
specification_response:
Method Signature:
    method DegreesToRadians(degrees: real) returns (radians: real)
Postconditions_prompt:
    - The returned radians value is the input degrees converted to radians using the formula radians = degrees * (pi / 180)
code_response:

In this case:
    method DegreesToRadians(degrees: real) returns (radians: real)

Dafny specification:
